replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics feels like a distant language I struggle to speak fluently. While I appreciate its logic, my heart leans more towards literature and history. It often seems abstract and disconnected from the human stories I love exploring in novels.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, absolutely. The pressure to understand complex formulas triggers a deep sense of insecurity. My low extraversion makes me withdraw rather than ask for help, while my conscientiousness drives me to overthink every mistake until I feel overwhelmed and paralyzed.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I have used AI tools occasionally. They are helpful for checking answers quickly, but they sometimes make me feel even more inadequate when I can't follow their explanations. It feels like a shortcut that doesn't help me truly understand the underlying concepts.
